name: Employment Ontario employment services (free job-search help)
organization: Government of Ontario - Employment Ontario (local service providers)
summary: Free one-on-one job-search help in Ontario (resumes, interview prep, job matching and referrals to funded training) through more than 700 local Employment Ontario locations.
whatYouDo: You connect with a local provider and work with an employment counsellor on a job-search plan, your resume and interview skills, and introductions to employers. Providers are also the door to funded programs such as Better Jobs Ontario and pre-apprenticeship training. Self-serve job information is open to anyone.
appeal: Gateway to funded training (Better Jobs Ontario, pre-apprenticeship) and youth supports
Self-service information open to anyone, including people who are employed or students
watchOuts: Full assisted services usually target people who are unemployed or working under about 20 hours a week and not in full-time school (provider rules vary)
Usually requires Ontario residence and legal entitlement to work in Canada
Quality and offerings vary by provider; it is help to find work, not a paid job

System was restructured as Integrated Employment Services (rolled out province-wide by March 2025) and now absorbs social-assistance employment supports; disability advocates criticized parts of the change
No first-hand user reviews found in this research pass

training.notes: Can refer you to funded training such as Better Jobs Ontario or pre-apprenticeship programs.

compensation.notes: Free service, not a paid job. Older youth streams (e.g., Youth Job Connection) offered paid pre-employment training/placements, but current availability varies by region.

reliability.notes: Outcomes depend on the local provider and labour market; not measured here.

applicationSteps: Call 1-800-387-5656 or use the 'find services in your area' tool on ontario.ca/employmentontario
Contact a nearby provider and complete an intake conversation to confirm eligibility
Work with a counsellor on a job-search plan, resume, interview prep and referrals
fitsIf: You live in Ontario, can legally work in Canada and want free, personal help with your job search or with getting into funded training.
notFitIf: You need paid work immediately or prefer a fully self-directed job search.
